app.name: Indent Easy
app.tagline: Indents, approvals, procurement and stock in one place

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your work e-mail address or employee code.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Your tasks will appear here as each workspace is built. For now this page shows that the app, the API and the database are connected.
dashboard.flagsEmpty: No feature flags are set up for this organisation yet.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you asked for doesn't exist.

validation.passwordPersonal: Don’t build the password from your e-mail address or employee code.
validation.passwordBreached: This password has appeared in a data breach elsewhere. Choose another one.
validation.passwordUnchanged: The new password must be different from the current one.
validation.passwordMismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
validation.mobile: Enter the number with its country code, e.g. +919876543210.
validation.dateOrder: The end date must be on or after the start date.
validation.notFound: This no longer exists. Reload and try again.
validation.emailTaken: Another user already has this e-mail address.
validation.employeeCodeTaken: Another user already has this employee code.
validation.deliveryPointTaken: Another user already has this delivery point code.
validation.codeTaken: This code is already in use.
validation.versionConflict: Someone else changed this meanwhile. Reload and try again.
validation.beyondYourAccess: You can only give access that you have yourself.
validation.lastSuperAdmin: The organisation needs at least one active super administrator.
validation.cannotBlockSelf: You cannot deactivate or lock your own account.
validation.invalidStatus: This status cannot be set by hand.
validation.duplicateRole: Each role can be given only once.
validation.superAdminKeepsAll: The super administrator role always has every permission.

auth.invalidCredentials: The e-mail address, employee code or password is incorrect.
auth.locked: Too many attempts. This account is locked for {{minutes}} minutes, or until an administrator unlocks it.
auth.disabled: This account has been disabled. Contact your administrator.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait {{minutes}} minutes and try again.
auth.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
auth.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
auth.forgotIntro: Enter the e-mail address of your account. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.linkSent: If an account uses this address, a reset link is on its way. It works once, for 30 minutes.
auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A few unrelated words work well; no special characters needed.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been changed and you have been signed out everywhere. Sign in with the new password.
auth.resetLinkInvalid: This reset link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
auth.resetLinkMissing: This page needs the link from the reset e-mail.
auth.changeRequired: Choose a new password before you continue. The one you signed in with was temporary.
auth.signOutOthers: Sign out on my other devices

admin.title: Administration
admin.noAccess: You do not have access to administration.
admin.name: Name
admin.sendInvite: E-mail an invitation to choose a password
admin.sendInviteHint: The link works for 72 hours. Without it, use “Send password reset” later.
admin.userCreated: User created. An invitation has been e-mailed.
admin.scopeLocationsHint: None ticked: the whole organisation. A store user without locations gets their own.
admin.rolesSaved: Roles saved. The user’s access changes on their next request.
admin.deactivateConfirmBody: They are signed out on every device at once and can no longer sign in. You can reactivate them later.
admin.forceResetConfirmBody: They are signed out everywhere and get an e-mail link, valid for 24 hours. Their current password must be changed at the next sign-in.
admin.roleCodeHint: Capital letters, digits and _. System role codes cannot change.
